description.value:
While you are wearing light or no armor and using no shield, you can use a Bonus Action to enter the Dervish Dance for 1 minute, gaining the benefits below. It ends early if you are Incapacitated and if you don medium or heavy armor or a shield. You can also end it early (no action required).

  • Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
  • On each of your turns, you can give all your melee weapon attacks the benefits of the Flurry or Cleave mastery (your choice). These do not limit your use of other masteries on your attacks, but you cannot use the same mastery twice on the same attack.
  • You have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
  • Your AC increases by 1 + half your Proficiency (rounded down).

You can use this feature twice, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a Short or a Long Rest. Additionally, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to use it again (no action required).
